content.text:
I changed `TokenEndpoint.java` so a `TokenInterceptorException` now produces an error event. I did not compile it or run any tests. My one `mvn` compile attempt failed offline on an unresolved `maven-build-cache-extension`.

In the `catch (TokenInterceptorException e)` block, `TokenEndpoint` now records the exception's description as the event reason. It adds the requested `resource` values from the form params as an event detail, so the rejected resource shows up in the log. It then calls `event.error(e.getError())`, which for the resource indicator checks is `invalid_target`. Before this, that block only returned the error response, so no event was logged. I added the `OAuth2Constants` import the new code needs.

The catch block is shared, so `OrganizationTokenPostProcessor` failures will now also log an event, with `invalid_request` as the error.

I didn't use the axiomengine graph, since this repo has no index and the change was small.
